name: stack
description: A Flexbox stack — `direction` picks the axis, `gap` the spacing (a density-scaled Context token per step), and `align`/`justify` the alignment, all as modifier classes. No inline styles: the alignment props are curated presets, not raw CSS keywords (RFC 0022 §8).

modifiers.name: gap
modifiers.description: Space between children; each step (except none) is a density-scaled Context token.

modifiers.name: align
modifiers.description: Cross-axis alignment (`align-items`), as a preset set rather than a raw CSS passthrough.

options.name: start
options.description: Children packed at the cross-axis start edge.

options.name: center
options.description: Children centred on the cross axis.

options.name: end
options.description: Children packed at the cross-axis end edge.

options.name: stretch
options.description: Children fill the cross axis (the default).

options.name: baseline
options.description: Children aligned on their first text baseline.

modifiers.name: justify
modifiers.description: Main-axis distribution (`justify-content`), as a preset set rather than a raw CSS passthrough.

options.name: start
options.description: Children packed at the main-axis start edge (the default).

options.name: center
options.description: Children centred on the main axis.

options.name: end
options.description: Children packed at the main-axis end edge.

options.name: between
options.description: Equal space between children, none at the edges.

options.name: evenly
options.description: Equal space between children and at the edges.
